_comment: Sample ZeroBias tasks (remediation / workflow items). Tasks are a ZeroBias platform concept (proprietary workflow SDK) so they fall back to this sample offline. Each task is tied to a real finding in the bundled boundaries (MFA-disabled IAM users, the failing OpenSSL CVE, the partial-fail STIG control) so the views stay internally consistent.

tasks.title: Remediate CVE-2025-9999 (OpenSSL) in checkout image
tasks.description: Rebuild the checkout container on a patched base image (openssl >= 3.0.14). Vulnerable runtime detected by the Q2 attestation scan.

tasks.title: Enable MFA for deploy-bot and ci-runner
tasks.description: Two IAM service accounts in acme-prod have MFA disabled. Rotate to short-lived credentials or enforce MFA.

tasks.title: Pin nginx TLS STIG to compliant ciphers
tasks.description: Container STIG control nginx-tls is partial-fail. Restrict to TLS 1.2+ and the approved cipher suite.

tasks.title: Review Azure firewall egress rules
tasks.description: Contoso Azure platform boundary flagged a critical open egress path. Confirm intended and document the exception.

tasks.title: Q2 attestation sign-off
tasks.description: Final reviewer sign-off on the checkout service Q2 boundary snapshot.

tasks.title: Verify route-table egress chain on app subnet
tasks.description: Confirm app-tier instances egress only through the NAT gateway, not directly to the IGW.
